children: $560M in new financing led by WhiteHawk Capital Partners to fund further development of its Bally’s Bronx project and for general corporate purposes.
The financing includes $400M of closing-date term loan commitments and $160M of delayed-draw term loan commitments.
The poceeds will fund pre-construction costs and other expenditures related to the Bronx project, with a portion available for general corporate purposes.
The finacing is expected to close in Q3.

title: Bally’s secures $560M financing for Bronx casino project
